text:
Maya R.: Quick sync — Spectra joint perf smoke. Goal: single-day lab run to validate perf/W improvements from our kernel micropatches. Target: steady 2k toks/s +-10% and >10% perf/W uplift vs their baseline. Need owners for telemetry, patches, and comms.
Theo Lin: I can do the telemetry. Plan to stream 1s samples for pdu_watts + token latency. Which models?
Maya R.: Use redwood-bench-compact v1 inputs. Models: spectramodel-7b-q4 and redwood-mpt-7b-q4. KV cache off, deterministic seed. Batch sizes 1,8,32.
Priya S.: I will package the kernel micropatches as drop-in modules under /opt/redwood/modules and provide a short apply.sh. Will include rollback steps. Also will run a signed scan and attach the assessment.
BenchBot: Reservation: spectra-lab-1 booked Thu 08:00-12:00 PT for `spectra_smoke`. Use `@BenchBot extend spectra-lab-1 1h` to add time.
Theo Lin: Telemetry schema draft: {ts, run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens, latency_ms, gpu_watts, pdu_watts}. Will post PR with example payload by EOD Tue.
Maya R.: Comms: Spectra requested a partner quote. We'll hold public numbers until post-validation window (48h). Priya share security notes early so legal can sign off.
Priya S.: Will add perf/W regression guard: abort if uplift <8% or perf/W drops >3% vs our reference.
Maya R.: Run command we will use:
```bash
./run_smoke --suite redwood-bench-compact-v1 \
  --models spectramodel-7b-q4,redwood-mpt-7b-q4 \
  --seq 2048 --batches 1,8,32 \
  --metrics throughput,latency,perf_per_watt \
  --out traces/spectra_smoke
```
Priya S.: I'll upload module tarball + apply.sh to /artifacts/spectra/smoke\.tar.gz by Wed AM.
Maya R.: OK team — aim to close PRs by Wed EOD, dry-run Wed 14:00 PT. Thanks. :raised_hands:
